slides.title: Your homepage says the *same thing* as theirs.
slides.sub: And customers can't tell you apart.

caption:
Open your website. Now open your closest competitor's.

If you swapped the logos, would anyone notice?

Most Kenyan business websites open with the same lines: "quality service", "customer satisfaction", "affordable prices". Nobody chooses you because of a line everyone else uses.

Your top line should say something only you can say.

Do this today: write one sentence about what you do that your competitor could not honestly copy. That sentence is your new headline.

Want a second pair of eyes on it? DM us your website link.
